Proposition
[Topologically Evenly Covered Neighborhoods]

1. ch4:4.39If $\pi :E\to M$ is a smooth covering map and $U\subseteq M$ is evenly covered in the topological sense, each component of $\pi ^{-1}(U)$ maps diffeomorphically onto $U$. Thus the topological and smooth notions of evenly covered agree.
